human_in_loop.evidence_quote: When the agent pauses for user intervention — to run a command, apply an edit, take the next step — that paused state is part of the document.
human_in_loop.note: Strategies such as `yolo` and `read-only` change the gating policy.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: It's a Yjs document, not a transcript. Create sub-threads, drill down, backtrack, compare, and edit.
short_term_state.note: Session is a structured tree document with item properties, not a flat message list.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: MCP servers and skills plug into the same document
long_term_memory.note: Skills loaded across sessions; no cross-run notes/vector store documented.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: you can quit or relaunch and it resumes every conversation exactly where you left it

self_verification.evidence_quote: **Strategy** | Controls how the agentic loop runs — turns, tools, stopping
self_verification.note: No harness-enforced tests, linting of edits, or judge documented in the available evidence.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The turn is retried once, and the loop continues.
retry_policy.note: Only a context-overflow turn retry, not task-level retries.

rollback.evidence_quote: Any point can branch into a sub-thread. Sub-threads can branch again. You can navigate, inspect, and edit the structure directly.
rollback.note: Conversation branching is not a filesystem/git rollback; no undo tool documented.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Controls how the agentic loop runs — turns, tools, stopping
termination_condition.note: max_tokens/context refusal and spend ceiling per docs/context-window.md ("capped at 8 reduction passes and 64 hidden calls with a spend ceiling").

cost_controls.evidence_quote: capped at 8 reduction passes and 64 hidden calls with a spend ceiling
cost_controls.note: caching: cmd/juggler/providers/anthropic/cache_control_test.go, prompt_cache_key_test.go; routing: cmd/juggler/core/cheap_model.go selects a cheaper model for auxiliary calls.

timeouts.note: Shell watchdog implies per-command timeout; no run-level timeout found.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: It does all the work: HTTP/WebSocket server, session store, tool execution.

filesystem_access.note: Write-scope validation suggests writes limited to the project; reads may be broader.

network_policy.note: Web fetch/search ops present; no egress restriction documented.
